organization: St. Paul Lutheran Church. American Lutheran Church Women (Ottumwa, Iowa)

recipes.title: RIBBON SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve lime jello in 2 cups hot water. Add 2 cups cold water. pour into 14 x 10 x 2 pan. Chill until partially set. Dissolve lemon jello in 1 cup hot water in top of double boiler. Add marshmellows and stir to melt. Remove from heat. Add 1 cup drained pineapple juice and cream cheese. Beat until well blended andâ€™ stir in pineapple. Cool slightly. Fold in whipped cream and mayonnaise. Chill. Pour in layer over lime jello. Chill until almost set. Dissolve cherry jello in 2 cups hot and 2 cups cold water. Chill until syrupy. Pour over pineapple layer. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: APRICOT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix all the above and put in 9 x 13 dish. When firm, top with the following: 1 cup mixed pineapple and apricot juice, 3 tbls. spoons flour, 1 beaten egg, 4, cup sugar, 2 tbles. butter. Cook this until thick. When cool, add 1 cup cream whipped. Spread over jello and top with grated cheese.

recipes.title: QUEEN'S SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix and chill until slightly jelled. Then add drained pineapple, bananas, lemon juice and miniature marshmallows. When above is firm, put the following custard on top: Use drained pineapple juice and water to make 1 cup. Add 1/2 cup sugar and 2 tbls. flour mixed together. Add 1 beaten egg and 2 tbls butter. Boil until thick, then cool. Fold in 1 cup cream whipped (1 pkg. dream whip). Spread over mixture and top with grated cheese. Serve on lettuce with a few fancy crackers.

recipes.title: MOUNTAIN DEW SALAD
recipes.instructions: Refrigerate until set, then top with topping. 1 envelope Dream Whip (stiff) Fold in pkg. of lemon pudding andpie mix dry Refrigerate until set.

recipes.title: HALLOWEEN SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix jello according to pkg. and add black prunes.

recipes.title: CHERRY SALAD SUPREME
recipes.instructions: Dissolve raspberry jello in 1 cup boiling water. Stir in pie filling. Turn into a 9 x 9 x 2 baking dish. Chill until set. Dissolve lemon jello in 1 cup boiling water. Beat together cream cheese and mayonnaise. Slowly add lemon jello. Stir in undrained pineapple. Whip cream, fold into lemon mixture together with the marshmallows. Spread atop cherry Layer and sprinkle with nuts. Chill until set. You can use any flavor jello and pie filling.

recipes.title: 7 UP JELLO SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve 1 pkg. lime jello in 3/4 cup hot water. Add 1 bottle 7 Up soda. When it starts to set, add 3 bananas (cut very fine) and 1/2 cup walnuts (cut very fine). Refrigerate and chill until firm.

recipes.title: SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water and add rest of ingredients. Chill until set and frost with: 1 pkg. (large) cream cheese 2 tbls. cream 2 tbls. salad dressing dash of salt

recipes.title: GREEN AND WHITE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve Knox gelatine in 1/2 cup cold water, add salt and 1 cup boiling water. Stir until thoroughly dissolved. Cool. Blend cream cheese and sour cream or whipped cream. Add with cottage cheese to Knox mixture and pour into mold. Chill until set.. Dissolve lime jello in 1 cup boiling water. Add pineapple juice, cold water and drained pineapple. Pour over firm cottage cheese mixture in mold. Refrigerate at least 3 hr. Top with dressing if you wish.

recipes.title: SHERBERT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix gelatin, hot water and orange sherbert. When slightly thickened, add orange slices, bananas and nuts. Chill.

recipes.title: ORANGE SHERBERT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Press into a 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 325 for 20 to 25. min. Drain mandarin oranges reserving liquid. Dissolve gelatin in the hot water. Add water to the orange liquid to make 1 cup and add to jello. Chill until slightly thickened. Beat until frothy. Add sherbert and beat until well blended. Fold in orange sections. Pour in baked crust and chill.

recipes.title: DELICIOUS SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve red hots in hot water. While water is still hot, dissolve gelatine. Let cool and add appleÃƒÂ©guce. Pour half of mixture into a mold and let set. Whip togefher the cream cheese, cream and mayonnaise. Spread over the set mixture in the mold. Cool. Then add remaining jello.

recipes.title: CHERRY SNOW SALAD
recipes.instructions: Make jello according to package. Cool until almost set. Add Cool Whip and beat with rotary beater. Add fruit and chill.

recipes.title: JELLO SALAD

ingredients.name: red rasberry jello - dissolved in 1 cup hot water

recipes.instructions: Chill jello (do not let it start to set) and then add the raspberries and apple sauce. Whip [sour cream and marshmellows] together thoroughly and let stand for a long time.

recipes.title: HORSERADISH MOLD
recipes.instructions: Stir jello into hot water and when nearly set, add 4 tbls. horseradish, 1/4 teas. salt, 1/2 teas. paprika, 1/4 cup stuffed olvies. (sliced), 1/2 cup cream whipped. Pour in mold. Very good with ham.

recipes.title: RASPBERRY DELIGHT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Combine jello and hot water. Add ice cream and then orange juice. Let partly thicken. Add fruit and nuts. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: JELLO APPLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Prepare jello as directed on box. Cool to syrupy stage. Stir in apples a nd celery. Pour into 8in square pan. Sprinkle with nut meats. Chill until firm. Serve on lettuce with dressing if you wish.

recipes.title: SUNSHINE SALAD
recipes.instructions: For base dissolve both packages of gelatin in hot,add cold water and cool until consistency of unbeaten egg white. Add fruit and marshmallows. Pour into 9 x 13 pan. Chill. For topping combine first 5 ingredients into sauce pan and cook until thick. Cool. Fold in whipped cream and spread over chilled gelatine. Sprinkle with cheese. Pour in mold. Chill. Easy to double.

recipes.title: STRAWBERRY DELIGHT
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello and add bananas, pineapple and strawberries, divide into 2 parts. Place 1 part in 9 x 9 dish and chill until very firm. Spread with sour cream and add the other half of jello mixture. Chill at least 6 hours.

recipes.title: ZESTY LIME MOLD
recipes.instructions: Heat inger ale to boiling and dissolve lime jello in it. Cool until syrupy. Add fruits. Turn in a 4 cup mold. Chill. Serves 6.

recipes.title: CLUB SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix 1 pkg. lime jello. Pour into 9 x 12 x 2 or in mold and let set until hard. Dissolve 1 pkg. lemon jello. While jello is still hot, mix in 15 marshmallows so they will dissolve. Cool. Then add 1 cup whipped cream, 1 small can crushed pineapple (drain), 1/2 cup sugar and 1 pkg. cream cheese. Pour this over first jello and let set until hard. Lastly mix 1 pkg. cherry jello, cool and pour on top of other layers. Let it harden. This is very colorful at Christmas

recipes.title: PARTY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in water, add cherry and lemon juice. Chill slightly. Fold in fruit. Pour into mold. Chill.

recipes.title: ORANGE SHERBET SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve gelatine in boiling water. Add sherbert. Stir well, then add fruit. Chill. Serves 12 - 15.

recipes.title: VELVET CREAM SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Whip cream and add salad dressing to it is same bowland beat until completely blended. Next stir in gelatine and add marshmallows, pineapple and chopped cherries. Turn into mold and chill.

recipes.title: LIME SALAD

ingredients.name: cream cheese or 1 cup cottage cheese

recipes.instructions: Whip jello then fold in pineapple, cheese and whipped cream. Add salt.

recipes.title: GOLDEN FRUIT SALAD

ingredients.name: heavy cream or 2 oz. pkg. dessert topping mix whipped

recipes.instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water, add cold water. Chill until syrupy. Drain fruit reserving 1 cup liquid. Fold fruit into chilled jello and pour into 12 x 7 x 2 pan. Chill over night and frost with Fluffy Topping. Top with 1/4 cup grated cheese. [Fluffy Topping] Combine sugar and corn starch in heavy saucepan. Blend in egg and liquid. Cook, stirring constantly, over low heat until thickened. Remove from heat, stir in butter and lemon juice. Cool. Fold in whippedd cream or topping mix.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE - BANANA SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello, mix in rest of ingredients and let set. Topping: Cook 1 egg, 2 tbls flour, 1/2 cup sugar and liquid from pineapple and enough water to make 1 cup. Let cool. Whip 1 cup cream and mix with cooked mixture. Put on jello. Sprinkle with greated cheese.

recipes.title: CUCUMBER - PINEAPPLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 1/2 cups boiling water and add 1 1/2 cups cold water including pineapple juice drained from pineapple. Chill until syrupy and whip slightly. Add pineapple and drained cucumber to jello. Whip cream, add salad dressing and add to jello mixture. Chill. You may add almonds or miniature marshmallows if you like.

recipes.title: PEACH SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in water. Add soda and rest of ingredients. Chill.

recipes.title: BREATH OF SPRING SALAD
recipes.instructions: Drain pineapple, reserve syrup and add enough water to make 1 1/2 cups. Heat to boiling. Dissolve lemon jello in it. Arrange pineapple slices in pyrex dish. Put a maraschino cherry in eath center. Pour lemon jello over. Chill until set. Dissolve_lime jello in boiling water. Add cottage cheese and mix well. Cool until syrupy. Pour over pineapple lemon layer. Chill until firm. Cut with pineapple slice in each serving. Serves 8.

recipes.title: BEET AND CABBAGE SALAD

ingredients.name: beets and red cabbage. Both cooked and chopped.

recipes.instructions: Equal portions of beets and red cabbage. Both cooked and chopped. White cabbage may be used. Add horseradish (1 bottle) or to taste. Heat to boiling cider vinegar, sugar and salt. Mix with rest of ingredients and heat thoroughly. About 2 or 3 min.

recipes.title: CABBAGE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix and bring to boil (do not boil). Pour over vegatables. Will keep for some time.

recipes.title: CABBAGE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Let stand 1 hour. Drain well. Boil 5 minutes and let cool: 2 cups vinegar 3 cups sugar 1 cup water. Add: 1/2 cup diced green peppers 2 cups celery diced 1/2 cup diced onions (optional) A little celery seed. Put in jar or container.

recipes.title: POINSETTA SALAD
recipes.instructions: Lettuce bed with tomato wedges arranged like a poinsetta. Sprinkle chopped hard boiled eggs in center. Garnish with green pepper stems.

recipes.title: PERFECTION SALAD
recipes.instructions: Thoroughly mix gelatin, sugar and salt, stirring until sugar dissolves. Add lemon juice and vinegar, cool. When mixture begins to thicken add remaining ingredients. Pour into 9 x 5 x 2 pan. Garnish with ripe olives.

recipes.title: KRAUT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix the abo ve together and let stand over night.

recipes.title: NEW CABBAGE SLAW
recipes.instructions: Combine above ingredients and chill, then combine: 1/2 cup salad dressing 2 tbls. vinegar 1 tsp. prepared mustard. Pour over vegetables and toss lightly. Serve in leafy cabbage bowl and trim with cucumber cuts.

recipes.title: ANTIPASTO FOR BUFFET SALAD
recipes.instructions: Bring to a boil, add vegetables and cook for 10 minutes. Let cool and serve. Will keep 3 - 4 weeks in refrigerator.

recipes.title: BACON AND MACARONI SALAD
recipes.instructions: Cook macaroni as directed on package. Fry bacon until crisp and drain on paper towel. Add bacon and remaining ingredients to drained macaroni. Mix lightly to combine evenly. Chill.

recipes.title: COOL AS A CUCUMBER SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water and cool until slightly thickened. Beat together vinegar and mayonnaise. Add to gelatin with cucumber and onion. Serves 6.

recipes.title: APPLE PINEAPPLE COLESLAW
recipes.instructions: Combine, tossing until mayonnaise coats all ingredients. Serves 4 - 6.

recipes.title: MENS FAVORITE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Heat onions in a moderate oven for a few minutes to crispen. Wash greens throughly. Break lettuce and spinach in bite size pieces. Scatter warm onions on top. Add dressing. Toss lightly.

recipes.title: CABBAGE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Sprinkle with salt and set aside. Boil until sugar has dissolved. Pour over cabbage when it has cooled a bit. This dressing will keep up to a month without getting strong.

recipes.title: CUCUMBER SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add vinegar, salt and onion. Chill until it starts to set. Add sour cream and salad dressing, mix well. Fold in cucumbers. Pour into individual molds. Serve on lettuce. Serves 6.

recipes.title: THREE P SALAD
recipes.instructions: Add a little sweet pickle vinegar to dressing for flavor.

recipes.title: BEAN SALAD
recipes.instructions: Strain all juice off above and mix with: 1 cup vinegar 1 cup salad oil 1 cup sugar. Place in refrigerator and let chill for 24 hours before serving.

recipes.title: RED CABBAGE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Shredded cabbage, salt, pepper and sugar to taste. Sprinkle with vinegar and let stand for 10 min. Red cabbage will change to a beautiful red. Add salad oil and serve.

recipes.title: POINSETTA SALAD
recipes.instructions: Select firm ripe tomatoes; scald, peel and chill. Place tomatoes on lettuce, cut in 1/8 parts and open like flower petals. Season cottage cheese with salt and paprika and force thru ricer. Fill tomatoes with cheese and serve with french dressing to which has been added green pepper. Sprinkle top with chopped nuts.

recipes.title: COTTAGE CHEESE RELISH
recipes.instructions: Blend sour cream with cottage cheese. Stir in chilled vegetables, salt and pepper. Serve on Lettuce. Team with tomato and green pepper slices and olives on relish tray. Serves 4.

recipes.title: CITRUS PERFECTION SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add vinegar and salt. Drain grapefruit reserving syrup. Add water to syrup to make 1 cup, add to gelatine. Chill until partly set. Stir in grapefruit and re-maining ingredients. Turn into 1 qt. mold. Chill. Serves 6.

recipes.title: BEET SALAD
recipes.instructions: Drain beets and use 1 cup beet juice with 1 cup hot water and add to jello. Add 1/2 cup beets and celery. Serve on lettuce with mayonnaise.

recipes.title: QUIK SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix together with vinegar and oil dressing.

recipes.title: LORETTO SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix with salad dressing.

recipes.title: POTATO SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix egg, vinegar, sugar, salt and flour together. Cook until thick. Add mustard and butter and let cool. Thin with a little cream and stir into potatoes.

recipes.title: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
recipes.instructions: Cook potatoes; peel and dice. Add vinegar and seasonings. Fry bacon until crisp. Cook eggs just 4 min. Combine potatoes, bacon and 2 tbls. bacon fat, onion and soft cooked eggs. Mix well and sprinkle top with little pieces of bacon. Serves 8.

recipes.title: SOUR CREAM POTATO SALAD

ingredients.name: potatoes cooked in jackets, peeled and sliced to make 6 cups
salt and celery seed to taste

recipes.instructions: While potatoes are warm, pour dressing over and then chill for 2 hours. Add celery and onions. Chop egg whites and add. Seive yolks; reserve some for garnish. Combine remaining egg yolk with mayonnaise, sour cream and mustard. Fold into salad. Add salt and celery seed. Chill salad for 2 hours. Add diced cucumber, mix. To trim, sprinkle reserved yolks and sliced onion tops over top.

recipes.title: GERMAN POTATO SALAD
recipes.instructions: Boil 6 or 8 med. potatoes in their jackets. Cool, remove skins and slice. Add chopped or cut up onions to taste. Cut bacon up fine and brown or just use bacon grease. Add vinegar, sugar and salt to taste and bring to boil. Uae vinegar enough that you think would mix thoroughly with potatoes. Pour hot over potatoes. Mix well.

recipes.title: POTATO SALAD
recipes.instructions: Cook potatoes, peel and cube. Mix together oil, vinegar, salt and pepper. Pour over cubed potatoes and refrigerate for several hours. Mix cream, mayonnaise, onions and eggs with potato mixture and refrigerate until ready to use.

recipes.title: SWISS CHEESE APPLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Quarter and core apples, dice. Sprinkle with lemon juice to keep from darkening. Add cheese, celery, salt and sour cream. Blend will. Serve in lettuce cups if desired.

recipes.title: QUICK SALAD
recipes.instructions: Cook flour, sugar, egg and pineapple juice until thickened. Turn off heat and add 2 tbls. cheese whiz. Let cool. Add 1 1/2 cup small marshmallows and pineapple.

recipes.title: FRUIT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix all ingredients together and chill in refrigerator until ready to serve, then add 2 cut up bananas. Mix well.

recipes.title: HAWAIIAN WALDORD SALAD
recipes.instructions: Combine and mix well. Serve on lettuce.

recipes.title: QUICK FRUIT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Place drained fruits and other ingredients in bowl. Fold in whipped cream. Other fruit mixture may be used. I use bananas and grapes for a change.

recipes.title: FRUIT SALAD WITH LEMON WILDERNESS
recipes.instructions: Add bananas and marshmallows shortly before serving on lettece. May garnish with whipped cream. Serves 8.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Blend 1/3 cup sugar and 2 tbls flour. Mix in 2 egg yolks. Drain a can of chunk pineapple and add juice to mixture and cook until thick. Combine with pineapple, marshmallows and bananas.

recipes.title: CANDLE LIGHT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Lettuce bed, slice of pineapple, place half banana in center, top with teaspoon salad dressing and sliver of almond. Light almond, it will burn.

recipes.title: MARSHMALLOW - APPLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Pare apple and bananas. Cube them and marshmallows into mixing bowl. Add sugar, cream, salad dressing and black walnuts. Stir thoroughly and put into bowl or dishes for serving. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: JUBILEE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Combine drained fruits, pie filling. Add marshmallows. Fold whipped cream into salad dressing. Mix. Serves 6 - 8.

recipes.title: FIVE CUP SALAD
recipes.instructions: Drain pineapple and mandarin oranges. Add cocoanut and sour cream. Mix well.

recipes.title: BANANA WALDORF SALAD
recipes.instructions: Sprinkle apples and bananas with lemon juice. Add marshmallows, celery and nuts with enough mayonnaise to moisten, toss lightly.

recipes.title: TWENTY FOUR HOUR SALAD.

ingredients.name: pared oranges cut up and drained

recipes.instructions: Combine egg yolks, sugar, vinegar, pineapple syrup, butter and salt in top of double boiler. Cook until thick stirring constantly. Cool. Stir in cherries, pineapple tidbits and marshmallows. Fold in whipped cream. Chill 24 hours. Place orange slices, marachino cherries, green seedless grapes over a salad. Tuck in sprig of mint. Serve as salad or dessert. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: LADIES DELIGHT FRUIT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix with salad dressing.

recipes.title: SPICY PEACH SALAD
recipes.instructions: Drain peaches, reserving syrup. Dissolve gelatin, sugar and spices in boiling water. Stir in peach syrup and vinegar. Chill until thick. Add peaches. Pour into 3 cup mold, chill until firm.

recipes.title: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Melt in double boiler: 1 tbls. butter. Add 1 tbls flour pineapple juice 1 tbls sugar 1 tbls. lemon juice 1 egg. Cook and stir until smooth. Cool and fold in 1 cup whipped cream. Fold in fruit and freeze.

recipes.title: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Add softened cream cheese to whipped cream, salad dressing and add fruit. Freeze in refrig. tray. Serve on lettuce.

recipes.title: FROSTY CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Combine cranberry sauce and crushed pineapple. Stir together sour cream and powered sugar, add to fruit mixture. Line a 3 cup refrig. tray with alum. foil. Pour in fruit mixture. Freeze firm. To serve, turn our frozen salad and let stand a few minutes at room temp. Remove foil and cut in 6 wedges. If desired, cut 3 well drained pineapple rings in half and place one atop each serving.

recipes.title: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Blend cream cheese, mayonnaise and salt. Add fruit and nuts. Fold in whipped cream. Package in airtight container. Freeze at once. Slice and serve frozen on lettuce.

recipes.title: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Whip cream, fold in mayonnaise and cocktail. Put in tray and freeze. Serve on lettuce.

recipes.title: CHERRY CREAM FREEZE
recipes.instructions: In large mixing bowl, combine milk, lemon juice, pie filling, pineapple and extract, mix well. Gently fold in whipped cream until evenly blended. Turn mixture into a 9x5x3 pan. Cover lightly with foil, freeze 24 hours. Unmold onto serving tray. Makes 2 quarts.

recipes.title: CHICKEN SALAD
recipes.instructions: Combine five ingredients and moisten with mayonnaise. Serve on salad greens and serve with additional egg slices and olives. Serves 6 - 8.

recipes.title: CHICKEN SALAD
recipes.instructions: Combine chicken celery and olives with enough mayonnaise to moisten. Slice 2 eggs in quarters. Force remaining egg through sieve. Arrange mixture on lettuce. Sprinkle with sieved egg.

recipes.title: OVEN CHICKEN SALAD

ingredients.name: toasted bread cubes or potato chips

recipes.instructions: Heat oven to 450 (hot). Combine all ingredients except cheese and 1 cup bread cubes, mix. Pile lightly into individual baking dishes or one large one. About 9 x 9 x 2 or deep bowl. Sprinkle with topping and grated cheese. Bake 10 - 15 min. or until bubbly. Serves 6.

recipes.title: CHICKEN SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix all but the chow mein noodles and chill in the refrigerator. Just before serving, toss in the noodles and serve. Leave the noodles until last so they stay crunchy.

recipes.title: CORNED BEEF SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. When partly set add other ingredients. Pour into lightly oiled mold. Serves 10 - 12.

recipes.title: FISH MOLD
recipes.instructions: Heat tomato soup, melt cheese in soup, then add gelatin that has been soaked in cold water. Cool. Add mayonnaise and salt and cool until it jells, then add rest of ingredients. Oil mold. If using fish mold, use olives for fish eyes.

recipes.title: MOLDED EGG SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve gelatin in water over low heat, stir constantly. Remove from heat; add lemon juice, salt, w. sauce and pepper. Chill until syrupy. Blend in remaining ingredients and chill until firm in 9 x 5 x 3 pan or mold. Serve on lettuce, garnish with sliced eggs, radishes, cucumber or pepper rings.

recipes.title: DELICATESSEN SALAD
recipes.instructions: Let marinate over night in refrigerator. Serve in bowl on lettuce leaf. Decorate with hard boiled eggs and capers. Serves 10 - 12. Good for luncheons and picnics.

recipes.title: SHRIMP _ WILD RICE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix together, add mayonnaise to taste and let stand overnight. Add can of water chestnuts, diced, two hours before serving.

recipes.title: FRESH SHRIMP SALAD

ingredients.name: Jumbo shrimp cut up into 4 pieces

recipes.instructions: Serve in lettuce cup on shredded lettuce. Garnish with tomato wedges and hard boiled eggs.

recipes.title: PINK CLOUD SALAD
recipes.instructions: Set 1 pkg. red jello until it begins to thicken. Whip until it holds peaks. Whip 1 cup cream and whip it into jello. Add 1 cup cranberry sauce and whip. Set overnight for best results.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Blend all ingredients. Chill and serve.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Grind raw cranberries and add sugar. Stir and leave in refrig. until cool and sugar is dissolved. Add marshmallows, pineapple and grapes. Last of all add nuts and fold in cream (whipped). This may be made ahead and frozen. Remove from freezer 2 - 3 hours before serving.

recipes.title: MOLDED CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Combine cranberries, sugar and water in sauce pan. Bring to a boil over med. heat. Lower heat and cook 5 min. Strain. Soften gelatine in cold water. Add to cranberry mixture together with salt. Cool until syrupy. Add celery and nuts. Pour into 1 large mold or into 8 individual molds. Chill until firm. Serve on lettuce.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY SALAD

ingredients.name: sugar, same amount as you have ground cranberries.

recipes.instructions: Mix and let cool. Grind cranberries, oranges and apples. Stir into chilled jello.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Boil cranberries, water and sugar together until berries are soft. While mixture is hot, whip in marshmallows and gelatin. Let cool, then add celery, apples and nuts. Chill 24 hours before serving. Will keep several days.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY CREAM SALAD
recipes.instructions: Break apart cranberry sauce and drain, reserving the liquid. Peel oranges and dice sections, reserving the juice. Combine cranberry liquid, orange and lemon juices and enough water to make 1 cup. Heat to boiling and pour over gelatin, stirring until dissolved. Add ice cream mixing until well blended. Chill until jelly-like in consistency (this will take only a short time). Fold in orange rind, diced oranges and cranberry sauce. Pour into 8 x 8 x 2 pan and chill until firm. Serves 8.

recipes.title: MOLDED CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Early in day: In medium bowl, dissolve strawberry jello with 1 cup hot water. Add cranberry relish. Pour into oiled 1 1/2 qt. mold. Chill until firm. Meanwhile in medium bowl prepare lime jello as label directs. Add food coloring. Chill until mixture is partially set. In small bowl, beat cream cheese with fork until fluffy. Add miracle whip and mix together well. Fold mixture into lime jello. Stir in whipped cream and marshmallows. Pour mixture over strawberry-cranberry layer. Chill until firm. Just before serving, turn mold out on platter and garnish with parsley. Serves 8.

recipes.title: FROSTY CRANBERRY MOLD

ingredients.name: heavy cream whipped or 1 pkg topping mix

recipes.instructions: Drain fruit, reserving liquid. Add water to make 2 cups. Bring to boil. Dissolve jello in hot liquid. Chill until partially set. Beat softened cream cheese and dressing together until fluffy. Gradually beat in jello. Fold this mixture into whipped cream. Set aside 1 1/2 cups of this mixture. Add drained fruit, nuts and apple to remaining cheese-jello mixture. Pour into 12 x 7 1/2 x 2 pan and refrigerate until surface sets, (about 20 min.) Frost with reserved topping. Refrigerate several hours. This may be frozen. Remove from freezer to refrigerator 1 hour before serving. Serves 12.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in 1 cup hot water. Cool. Grind cranberries and drain. Do not use juice. Boil cranberries for 1 minute with 2 cups sugar. Stir to prevent scorching. Cool. Drain pineapple. Add pulp only, to other ingredients. Combine all with jello. Refrigerate.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY ORANGE SALAD

ingredients.name: orange or 1 small can mandarin oranges cut up

recipes.instructions: Set jello with water and when slightly jelled, add rest of ingredients. Mold. Serves 8.

recipes.title: EASY CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water. Add lemon juice, cheese, salt, dressing and "blend well" with electric mixer. Chill until mixture begins to thicken. Whip until fluffy and stir in sauce, celery, almonds and pineapple.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY SALAD

ingredients.name: celery and apples or pineapple and grapes

recipes.instructions: Prepare 3 oz. pkg. lemon jello as directed. Grind 1 lb. cranberries. Add 1/2 cup sugar, cut up (celery and apples) or (pineapple and grapes) and nuts. Stir all into jello as it thickens. Use large bowl.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in water and cool until slightly set. Mix the cranberries with sugar and let set 30 minutes, then add to jello with rest of ingredients and mold.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in hot water, add cranberry sauce, and blend. Put apple and lemon thru food chopper and add to gelatin. Chill.

organization: St. Mary of Nazareth, Des Moines, Iowa

recipes.title: MELON BALL SALAD

ingredients.name: boiling water over jello, stir well
frozen orange juice, thawed but not diluted
frozen strawberries, thawed and strained (save juice)
frozen melon balls, thawed and strained (save juice)

recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello in boiling water. Add juices that were strained from strawberries and melon balls after bringing to boil. Add orange juice, stir well and chill until it begins to set. Fold in fruit. Refrigerate until set. Serve with cool whip spread on top.

recipes.title: PEAR SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix together and put in refrigerator until it sets a little. Mix together with electric mixer. Add to pear halves and cheese mixture and fold into lime jello.

recipes.title: QUICK COMPANY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Chill 3 hours. Serve on lettuce leaf.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE-BANANA SALAD
recipes.instructions: Drain pineapple into saucepan. In small bowl combine sugar and cornstarch. Add beaten egg to dry ingredients and mix well. Add entire mixture to pineapple juice and cook over medium heat until thick and clear. Place pineapple tidbits and desired amounts of sliced bananas and marshmallows in salad bowl and mix in dressing. The dressing is good made ahead and chilled or used immediately. This dressing will also keep for several days in a covered bowl in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: ORANGE-TAPIOCA SALAD
recipes.instructions: Drain [pineapple] & Save juice. Add enough water to make 3 c. liquid. Add to 1 pkg orange tapioca pudding mix and 1 pkg. Vanilla tapioca pudding mix. Cook as directed and let cool. Add oranges, pineapple, marshmallows. Add 1 pkg. whipped dream whip. Pour into 9 x 13 glass dish and refrigerate. If you can't find orange tapioca, use regular vanilla pudding.

recipes.title: STRAWBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve Jello in water, add berries, and undrained pineapple. Mash and beat bananas and add to jello mixture. Blend well and pour one-half the mixture into a 9 x 13 pan. Let set in refrigerator until firm. Spread carton of sour cream over jello mixture. Pour remaining Jello mixture over sour cream and return to refrigerator until firm.

recipes.title: SUNSHINE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Soften 1 envelope Knox gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water. Let stand. Heat to boiling 1 cup pineapple syrup, and stir in gelatin until dissolved. ADD: 1/2 cup orange juice 1/4 cup mild vinegar 1/4 cup sugar 1/4 tsp. salt. Stir until sugar is dissolved and cool. When mixture begins to thicken, fold in: 1 cup grated raw carrots 1 cup orange segments 1 1/2 cups pineapple tidbits. Turn into mold and chill. Serves 6.

recipes.title: MANDARIN ORANGE-PINEAPPLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Drain oranges, reserving juice. Dissolve gelatins in hot water. Add enough water to juice from oranges to make 1 cup. Stir into gelatin mixture. Chill until thickened. Fold in sherbet and fruits. Serves 12.

recipes.title: ORANGE PINEAPPLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix juice, egg, sugar and crushed pineapple in heavy saucepan, Cook, stirring until thick. Cool. Fold in remaining ingredients. Chill 8 hours.

recipes.title: FRUIT CASSEROLE
recipes.instructions: 1. Combine in 9x13 pan: 1 1b.13 oz. can pear halves 1 1b.13 0Z. can peaches 1 1b.13 0Z. can plums. 2. Spread on top of above mixture: 2 eggs 1 tsp. vanilla 1 1/2 cups sour cream 3 tbsp. brown sugar (from 1/3 cup) 1 tbsp. flour (from 3 tbsp.) Pour over fruit and bake at 350 deg. for 15 minutes. Add following topping and bake 15 minutes more: 2 Tbsp. softened butter 1 Tbsp. lemon or lime juice Remaining brown sugar & flour 1/4 tsp. nutmeg 1 pkg. crushed shortbread cookies

recipes.title: CHRISTMAS CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Cover above ingredients and chill overnight in refrigerator. Add apples, grapes, nuts, salt to first mixture. Fold in whipped cream. Chill. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: COOK & CHILL SALAD

ingredients.name: oranges, peeled and cut in small pieces

recipes.instructions: Whip the following together slightly: 3 egg yolks, 2 tbsp. sugar, 2 tbsp. vinegar, 2 tbsp. pineapple syrup, 1 tbsp. butter. Cook, stirring constantly until mixture coats a spoon. Cool. When cold, fold in 1 cup heavy cream, whipped. Fold this mixture into the following: 2 cups white cherries, drained, 2 cups miniature marshmallows, 2 cups pineapple tidbits, 2 oranges, peeled and cut in small pieces. Chill.

recipes.title: APPLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Fold in following dressing: 1/2 Cup Salad Dressing 1/2 Cup Whipped Cream

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE CHEESE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Soak gelatin in cold water for 5 minutes. Dissolve in boiling water. Add sugar, salt and pineapple. When mixture begins to congeal, fold in whipped cream and cheese,

recipes.title: APRICOT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve 2 pkgs. orange jello, in 2 cups boiling water. Add 1 cup pineapple juice, set aside to cool. When consistency of unbeaten egg white, stir in 1 - 2 1/2 can pineapple drained, and 1 - 2 1/2 can apricots, drained & snipped, 1/2 pkgs. miniature marshmallows. Pour into 9 x  13 in pan. Chill till firm, then top with following mixture. 1/2 cup sugar, 3 tbsp. flour, 1 cup juice from canned fruit, 1 egg beaten 2 tbsp. butter, 1 cup heavy cream, whipped, 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese. Combine sugar and flour with juice, cook over low heat stirring constantly until clear & thick. Add small amount to beaten egg. Add to pan, cook 1 minute. stir in butter, and when completely cool, fold in whipped cream. Spread over firm fruit mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Chill.

recipes.title: NEVER-TELL SALAD

ingredients.name: Cottage Cheese (cream cheese can be substituted)

recipes.instructions: Combine the above and heat until marshmallows are melted. Chill until it starts to thicken. Add: 1 Cup Cottage Cheese (cream cheese can be substituted) 1 Cup Whipped Cream 1/2 Cup pineapple chunks 1/2 Cup nut meats

recipes.title: APRICOT CREAM CHEESE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Heat 4 cups apricot nectar. Add 2 pkgs. lemon Jello to nectar, and stir to dissolve. Cool till partially set. Meanwhile, heat 2 additional cups apricot nectar. Add remaining pkg. jello, and stir to dissolve. Whip in cream cheese, which should be at room temperature. Chill until partially set. Place half plain mixture in a 2 qt. mold. Add the cheese layer, then the rest of the plain apricot jello. Chill until firm. 10 servings.

recipes.title: CHERRY CHEESE SALAD

ingredients.name: juice from Bing cherries and enough cold water to make a cup.
cream cheese, formed into small balls

recipes.instructions: Dissolve 1 pkg. Black Cherry Gelatin in 1 cup hot water. Add juice from Bing cherries and enough cold water to make a cup. Chill until slightly thickened. Add all this to thickened gelatin and chill until set. Serves 8.

recipes.title: RED, RED SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve gelatin in hot water. Add other ingredients. Raspberries need not be defrosted. Stir until they are separated. Fill five cup mold and chill.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY MOLDED SALAD
recipes.instructions: [cranberries, sugar and water] Boil for 6 minutes and cool. Let [jello and water] set a little. Combine above ingredients. Add a 12 oz. pkg. sour cream and 1 cup chopped nuts. Put in a mold and chill.

recipes.title: CHIFFON FRUIT SALAD

ingredients.name: hot peach syrup (or peach syrup & water)

recipes.instructions: Line bottom of mold with peach slices for garnish. Chop remaining slices. Mix hot peach syrup and gelatin to dissolve gelatin. Chill until thickened. Add celery, nuts & mayonnaise. Add chopped peaches. Blend. Mix with whipped Carnation Instant. Spoon into mold. Chill until firm (about 3 hours). Unmold on lettuce. To Whip Carnation Instant: 1. Mix 1/2 cup Carnation Instant Magic Crystals with 1/2 cup ice water. 2. Whip until soft peaks form (3-4 Min) Add 2 Tbsp. lemon juice. 3. Continue beating until stiff peaks form. (3-4 Minutes longer.)

recipes.title: FROSTED FRUIT
recipes.instructions: Combine above ingredients. Cook over low heat until thick and clear. Add 1 beaten egg and a dash of salt. Heat and cool. Pour over fruit. Toss lightly and chill overnight. Fold in 1 cup whipped cream (or 1 pkg. dream whip) and 3 sliced bananas. Chill. Serves 10 to 12.

recipes.title: MINTED FRUIT FREEZE
recipes.instructions: Melt jelly over low heat; gradually add to mayonnaise, mixing well. Add marshmallows and fruit. Fold in whipped cream. Pour into 1 1/2 qt. mold and freeze. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: CINNAMON JELLO SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve 2 pkgs. cherry jello in 2 cups of boiling water. Dissolve 1/2 cup of red hots in 1 cup of hot water. Add enough cold water to equal 2 cups liquid, and add to jello mixture. Cool until soft set, and add to above: 2 cups chopped apples, 2 cups chopped celery, 1 cup chopped nuts. Chill until firm.

recipes.title: FROZEN FRUIT SALAD

ingredients.name: large marshmallows - cut up - or 1 1/2 cups small marshmallows
whipping cream or 1 pkg. dream whip

recipes.instructions: Add pineapple and marshmallows to cream cheese. Fold in whipped cream, cherries and nuts. Put in container and freeze.

recipes.title: FROSTY MARSHMALLOW SALAD
recipes.instructions: Measure cherry juice-add water to make 2 cups. Heat and combine with Jello. Pour into a flat dish until partially set. Add Cherries. Topping: Heat marshmallows and milk. Stir until dissolved and cool. Fold in whipped cream and pineapple. Spread over jello and sprinkle with nuts.

recipes.title: FROZEN STRAWBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Heat 3 Tbsp. strawberry juice, add marshmallows. Stir until marshmallows are melted. Cool and add pineapple, strawberries, cottage cheese, and fold in whipped cream. Put in fluted cup cake liners, and freeze.

recipes.title: MAMA'S BLUEBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix the two pkgs. of Raspberry Jello with 2 cups of hot water and juice drained from blueberries and pineapple. Stir until well blended, then add both blueberries and pineapple. Put in refrigerator to chill. Make Cherry Or Strawberry Jello as directed and put in refrigerator until consistancy of egg white. Whip cream and add to half set Jello. Beat until well mixed and pour on top of other Jello and fruit mixture. Be sure fruit mixture is firm before adding second mixture.

recipes.title: RASPBERRY-APPLESAUCE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups boiling water. Mix berries with applesauce, add to dissolved gelatin. Pour into a 9 x 13 dish. Chill until set. Topping: In a bowl, mix sour cream and as many marshmallows as the cream will hold. Let stand overnight in refrigerator, then whip and spread in a thin layer over salad. For a fluffier topping, fold 1 cup whipped cream into the marshmallow mixture. Serves 12.

recipes.title: STRAWBERRY WINE MOLD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water; stir in wine. Set aside 12 nice berries for top of mold. Slice remaining berries and mix with sugar. Halve the 12 prettiest berries and arrange cut-side down in a 6 1/2 cup ring mold; cover with a thin layer of gelatin and chill until firm. Add remaining berries to the rest of the gelatin (slightly thickened) and pour over the first layer. Chill until firm. Serve on lettuce or watercress.

recipes.title: DOUBLE LEMON SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and stir in remaining ingredients. Chill in ring mold.

recipes.title: SHRIMP AND GRAPEFRUIT MOLD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve gelatin and salt in boiling water. Add cold water, vinegar and onion. Measure 1 1/2 cups, and chill till thickened slightly, add shrimp, grapefruit and green pepper. Pour into 6 cup mold. Blend mayonnaise into remaining gelatin. Add celery and spoon over set gelatin mixture. Chill till firm. Serves 6.

recipes.title: CUCUMBER SALAD MOLD

ingredients.name: cucumbers, grated with skins on to make 2 cupfuls. Add little water to make up difference, if necessary.
plain gelatin combined with 2 Tbsp. cold water
lemon gelatin, dissolved in 2 cups boiling water, and a little green coloring

recipes.instructions: Add the plain gelatin to the very hot water. Combine all ingredients in order given. Pour into a medium size well oiled mold, or a plain bowl. Let stand in refrigerator for 8 hours or longer or until very firm to the touch. This mold is delicious with any cold or hot meat dish or seafood, and is especially attractive for buffets.

recipes.title: LUNCHEON SALAD
recipes.instructions: Cook noodles until tender. Cook shrimp as directed on package. Cut in small pieces. Add to noodles, with remaining ingredients, and desired amount of mayonnaise. Chill in refrigerator. Serve as main course,with garlic bread.

recipes.title: TUNA SALAD MOLD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water. Add cold water, lemon juice, mayonnaise, and onion. Chill till very thick. Fold in remaining ingredients. Pour into 1 qt. mold. Serve on salad greens. Makes 4 cups.

recipes.title: SASSY SHRIMP MOLD
recipes.instructions: This is quick and easy to make, if you have cream cheese at room temperature when blending. Soften gelatin in water, stir over low heat until dissolved. Gradually add thousand island dressing to cream cheese; mix until well blended. Stir in lemon juice, salt and gelatin; fold in shrimp and celery. Pour into 1 qt. mold, chill until firm. Unmold. Serves 4-6.

recipes.title: CHICKEN SALAD
recipes.instructions: In mixer bowl, beat together cream cheese, sour cream and salt. Stir in celery, almonds and green pepper. Fold in chicken and grapes. Chill mixture thoroughly. Serves 8 to 10.

recipes.title: THANKSGIVING COLE SLAW
recipes.instructions: Shred 1 large head cabbage fine. Beat 4 eggs until light and frothy. Add 1/2 cup sugar, 1/2 cup cold water, 1/2 cup cider vinegar, 1/2 teas. salt, and dash pepper. Mix well, and cook in double boiler until thick. Remove from fire, and pour HOT dressing over cabbage. When cooled, put in refrigerator, until thoroughly chilled. Better if made 24 hours ahead.

recipes.title: CABBAGE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix together [sugar, vinegar, water], boil 2 minutes and cool. Shred two heads of cabbage, add 2 tbsp. salt. Let stand 1 hour, squeeze out juice. Add to cabbage 1 bunch celery chopped, 2 green peppers, chopped, 2 red peppers, chopped, 1 teas. celery seed, 1 teas. mustard seed. Add cooled syrup to cabbage mixture and refrigerate. After 24 hours this is very crisp, and will keep well in the refrigerator for several weeks.

recipes.title: BEAN & VEGETABLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Drain [beans] well and add 1 Large onion, cut in rings, 1 Small green pepper, diced, 2 Stalks celery, chopped. Over this pour the following mixture: 1 Tsp salt, dash of pepper, 1/3 cup salad oil, 3/4 cup sugar, 2/3 cup apple cider vinegar. Allow beans and vegetables to marinate 24 hours.

recipes.title: SPICED BEET SALAD
recipes.instructions: When gelatin is cool, add rest of ingredients. Serves 6 to 8.

recipes.title: WILTED LEAF LETTUCE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Tear lettuce in bowl. Season with salt, pepper. Add onion, sugar. Fry bacon crisp - crumble. Add vinegar and water to drippings, heat to boiling point. Pour over lettuce - toss till wilted. Add bacon & eggs. Very good.

recipes.title: KRAUT SALAD

ingredients.name: Sauerkraut - drain well, squeeze with hands

recipes.instructions: Mix well, cover & chill for 24 hours. Makes 6 cups. Keeps for a week.

recipes.title: CREAMY COLESLAW
recipes.instructions: Mix sour cream, celery seed, salt and sugar. Gradually blend in vinegar and oil. Add cabbage. Mix thoroughly and chill.

recipes.title: PHILADELPHIA STEW
recipes.instructions: Combine 1 t. salt, 1/4 teas. pepper, 1 teas. grated onion, 2 tbsp. sugar, 1/2 teas. dry mustard, 1/3 cup cider vinegar, and 2 tbsp. salad oil. Pour over cabbage.

recipes.title: SEASONED CABBAGE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello, add cold water and vinegar and let set until slightly thickened. Then add following: 1/2 cup cabbage, shredded, 1/4 cup carrots, chopped, 1/4 cup celery, chopped, 1/4 cup green olives, sliced, 1 tbsp. onion, chopped, Dash salt, 1 Tsp. sugar, and Dash of Beau Monde Herbs. Chill.

recipes.title: CAESAR SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mash garlic and add to salad oil let stand. Break lettuce in bowl. Add croutons and tomatoes. Strain salad oil to remove garlic. Pour over vegetables. Combine remaining ingredients; beat well. Pour over salad and toss lightly. Garnish with sliced tomatoes.

recipes.title: CAESAR SALAD, GOURMET
recipes.instructions: Start with large wooden salad bowl that is unfinished on the inside. Rub salad bowl surface with a cut garlic clove. Mash 1/2 of garlic clove with fork in bowl. Add 3 anchovy fillets (if you like.) 1 tbsp. salad oil, 1/2 teas. dry mustard, grind pepper over all. Cream mixture in bowl. Blend in 4 teas. lemon juice, 1 1/2 tbsp. salad vinegar, 1/2 teas. worcestershire sauce, and 2 more tbsp. salad oil. Blend and set aside. Place 1 egg in boiling water, and let stand 1 minute. Break into salad bowl. Blend till dressing looks creamy. Gently toss 8 cups of broken lettuce and romaine with dressing. Add 2 tbsp. parmesan cheese, and 1 packet Devonshire Plain Melba toast, broken. Toss & Serve. 6-8 servings.

organization: St. John's Evangelical and Reformed Church (Ackley, Iowa). Crescent Club

recipes.title: 24 HOUR SALAD
recipes.instructions: Cook 3 egg yolks, 1/4 cup cream, juice 2 lemons, 2 tablespoons sugar. When cool mix with the above. Whip 1 pint cream, stir into mixture and let stand in cool place 24 hours.

recipes.title: 24 HOUR SALAD
recipes.instructions: Cook above ingredients until thick. Cool. Add 1 cup cream whipped. Drain 1 can pineapple, 1/2 pound marshmallows, 1/4 pound almond meats. Mix with dressing and set away for 24 hours. Serves 10.

recipes.title: COMBINATION SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix together with salad dressing. Put whipped cream and maraschino cherries on top.

recipes.title: APPLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix with good salad dressing and 1/2 cup cream.

recipes.title: APPLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix together and add salad dressing which has been mixed with 1 cup whipped cream.

recipes.title: SHRIMP AND PINEAPPLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Remove black line from shrimp. Cut in pieces. Mix with dressing. Chill. Drain and chill pineapple. Mix all ingredients. Serve on crisp lettuce leaves and garnish with olives.

recipes.title: OVERNIGHT FRUIT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Put egg in double boiler, add vinegar and sugar, stir constantly until thick and smooth. Cool. Fold in the whipped cream and fruit. Pour into pan and place in refrigerator over night.

recipes.title: DELICIOUS SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix with salad dressing, serve on lettuce leaf, garnish with red cherries.

recipes.title: YUM-YUM SALAD
recipes.instructions: Combine first ingredients, chill until consistency of thick syrup. Fold in grated cheese and whipped cream, pour into mold and chill firm, serve on lettuce leaf, plain or with dressing. Dressing for above: Mix dry ingredients, add beaten egg, vinegar and water. Cook over boiling water until thick. When cold add cream.

recipes.title: GREEN AND WHITE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Pour into a mold and chill until firm. Second part: Pour over green.

recipes.title: PERFECTION SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix and cool.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Put cranberries and orange through food chopper, add sugar and boil two minutes. Dissolve the gelatine in 1 cup cold water, add to the hot mixture. Cool slightly. Add celery and nuts. Mold and serve on a lettuce leaf or on shredded lettuce with or without salad dressing.

recipes.title: PINEAPPLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Boil 1 cup pineapple juice, 2 eggs and 2 tablespoons flour. Cool and add 1 cup cream, whipped. Mix well.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Grind cranberries and oranges. Mix well and let mold.

recipes.title: CRANBERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Let stand over night in a cold place. Serve on lettuce leaf.

recipes.title: GOOD SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix together and set away for 12 hours in a cold place. Serve on lettuce leaf or shredded lettuce. It can be served immediately after making.

recipes.title: APPLE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Use your favorite dressing.

recipes.title: OLIVE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve the gelatine in 1/2 cup cold water, add to boiling water. Add the vinegar, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Place in refrigerator until the mixture starts to thicken. Then add the chopped olives, cabbage and apple. Pour into salad mold and chill firm. Unmold in nest of lettuce leaves. Garnish with sharp mayonnaise and sliced olives.

recipes.title: FROZEN GINGER ALE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Soak gelatine in orange juice five minutes. Add lemon juice and place in pan of hot water. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Add fruit and cool until slightly thickened. Fold in mayonnaise and cream, beaten stiff. Freeze in trays and serve on lettuce.

recipes.title: FROZEN SALAD

ingredients.name: Royal Anne cherries, pitted and stuffed with cream cheese and nuts

recipes.instructions: Place in ice box to chill. Make a dressing of the yolks of 4 eggs, 4 tablespoons sugar and 4 teaspoons lemon juice. Cook in double boiler until thick. Chill. Add to 1 pint whipped cream and then add marshmallows and pineapple. Add cherries after salad is in pans to mold. Freeze 3 hours.

recipes.title: COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD SUPREME
recipes.instructions: Mix above ingredients and chill three hours in refrigerator.
authors: Mrs. Albert Gabby, Cedar Falls, Iowa

recipes.title: ORANGE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Peel oranges, removing the white coating. Cut in small pieces. Cut marshmallows in small pieces, add to the orange and sugar. Stir all until sugar is dissolved. Put in the whipped cream, stirring lightly. Chill.

recipes.title: ORANGE-COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix ingredients well. Chill.

recipes.title: BING CHERRY SALAD
recipes.instructions: Dissolve jello with hot water and cherry juice. When jello starts to set add cherries and nut meats. Pour into molds or put in a pan and cut into squares. Serve with lettuce.

recipes.title: CABBAGE CARROT SALAD
recipes.instructions: Combine cabbage, carrots, salt and vinegar. Moisten with mayonnaise, arrange on crisp lettuce. Garnish with orange sections.

recipes.title: CABBAGE AND POTATO SALAD

ingredients.name: sweet red pepper (chopped) or 3 tablespoons chopped pimento

recipes.instructions: Mix cabbage lightly with potato, celery, pickle, pepper or pimento and mayonnaise. Season to taste. Pile lightly on lettuce leaf. Garnish with pimento.

recipes.title: TUNA OR CHICKEN SALAD

ingredients.name: tuna or desired amount of chicken

recipes.instructions: Mix with salad dressing.

recipes.title: PEA SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix. Add salad dressing and serve.

recipes.title: AEROPLANE SALAD
recipes.instructions: Mix with dressing to moisten. Eggs may be added if preferred.

recipes.title: HAM SALAD
recipes.instructions: Combine ham, eggs, celery, pickles and peppers. Moisten with dressing, season to taste. Mix lightly. Serve on crisp lettuce leaf.
